Video encoder libx264: CPU Software (Most Compatible, Higher CPU Use)h264_nvenc: NVIDIA GPU (Low CPU, Fast Hardware Encode)h264_amf: AMD GPU (Low CPU, Fast Hardware Encode)h264_qsv: Intel Quick Sync (Low CPU, Hardware Encode) Pick the engine your PC handles best. If stream stutters, try another.
Preset Faster preset = lighter load, softer picture. Slower = sharper picture, heavier load.
H.264 profile Usually keep High. Change only if a platform/device asks for it.
Pixel format Keep yuv420p for broad playback compatibility.
FPS Higher feels smoother but needs more upload and PC power.
Width Higher width looks clearer but needs more bitrate.
Height Higher height looks clearer but needs more bitrate.
Video bitrate Main picture quality knob. Higher = clearer, but uses more internet.
Min rate Raise this to keep quality steady and avoid sudden drops.
Max rate Cap for peaks. Keep near video bitrate for stable streaming.
Buffer size Bigger buffer smooths spikes; too small can cause bitrate swings.
Keyframe interval (sec) How often a full frame is sent. 2 seconds is safest for live.
Audio codec AAC is the common safe choice for streaming platforms.
Audio bitrate Higher = cleaner sound; music usually benefits from 160k or more.
Audio sample rate Use 44100 or 48000 for stable, standard audio.
Audio channels 2 = stereo (recommended). 1 = mono and uses less bitrate.
